extracted.intended_audience: appellants before the PTAB, patent practitioners, and parties involved in PTAB appeals
extracted.subtask_description: Procedure and limits for convening an Appeals Review Panel (ARP) and granting sua sponte rehearing of a PTAB decision, including scope of review, briefing limitations, and timing for issuance of the ARP decision.

rubrics_metrics.name: Authority to convene Appeals Review Panel (ARP)
rubrics_metrics.description: An Appeals Review Panel is convened in this ex parte appeal and the Board members identified on this Order will serve as the ARP for this case.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Identifies which Board members will serve as the ARP. Notes delegation of authority where applicable (e.g., Acting Director recused and authority delegated to a named judge).

rubrics_metrics.name: Granting rehearing sua sponte
rubrics_metrics.description: The panel has determined to grant rehearing sua sponte to review the Board’s Decision on Appeal and Decision on Request for Rehearing in the above-captioned case.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ARP may on its own motion (sua sponte) grant rehearing to revisit prior Board decisions; such rehearing is an available procedural remedy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scope of ARP review (focus of rehearing)
rubrics_metrics.description: The ARP review will focus on the Board’s new ground of rejection of claims 1–6 and 8–20 under 35 U.S.C. § 101.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The rehearing is limited in scope to the identified new ground(s) of rejection (here, § 101 for specified claims); other issues outside that identified scope are not the focus of this ARP action.

rubrics_metrics.name: Rehearing conducted on the existing record
rubrics_metrics.description: The ARP will conduct the rehearing based on the current record and no further briefing is authorized at this time.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Parties should not expect to submit additional briefing unless good cause is shown; the ARP's review uses the materials already of record before the Board.

rubrics_metrics.name: Timing for ARP decision
rubrics_metrics.description: Absent good cause, the ARP will issue a decision on rehearing within 60 days of this Order.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sets an expected timeline for issuance of the rehearing decision and indicates that extensions require good cause.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recusal and delegation of authority
rubrics_metrics.description: One named official is recused and took no part; the Acting Director has delegated her authority to a specified judge for PTAB matters.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Notes that recusal and formal delegation (via Notice of Delegation) affect who may act in convening or deciding ARP matters; provides reference to the delegation document link.
